limitations: Historical cohort was previously exposed; this is a mechanism diagnosis, not a fresh or confirmatory test.
Per-step teacher-anchor overlap and source-box drift do not establish GT accuracy or object identity.
No intermediate image/model decode was run; only saved cached step boxes and existing final readouts were checked.
No best-step selection, hyperparameter change, or GT-based decision was made.

readout_semantics.boxes: saved normalized cxcywh cached decoder boxes on the physical source-frame grid
readout_semantics.step_boxes: cached replay/head outputs; only one final full-model readout is saved per fitted arm
readout_semantics.supervised_frames: source-grid positions with a verified anchor in the locked reference
readout_semantics.teacher_anchor_iou: overlap with frozen R1 teacher anchors, not GT
readout_semantics.unobserved_frames: all remaining source-grid positions; drift is measured against saved source boxes
